labels.source: Jersey City 260-3: dwellings with four or fewer housing spaces are exempt; the 1983 date is only for buildings converted from nonpermanent use; low-rent public housing and newly constructed dwellings of 25 or more units in a redevelopment area are also exempt

probes.basis: four or fewer housing spaces is exempt by its unit count
the count rules out the small-building exemption; public housing and redevelopment-area exemptions are not shown by the data

probes.why: land-use code says 5 or more units
probes.basis: the count rules out the small-building exemption; public housing and redevelopment-area exemptions are not shown by the data

probes.why: built 1990: the 1983 date is only about conversions
probes.basis: the 1983 date must not exclude a 1990 building; whether it is a converted nonpermanent building is not shown
no age exemption reaches a 1970 building; public housing is not shown by the data
the new-construction exemption covers buildings completed between June 25, 1987 and June 25, 1992 only; public housing is not shown by the data
